compartmentalize

(verb). phân ra từng ngăn, phân ra từng loại

Life today is rigidly compartmentalized into work and leisure.

highlight

(verb). Làm nổi bật, nêu bật

I've highlighted the important passages in yellow.

survey

(noun). sự khảo sát, nghiên cứu

A recent survey showed 75 per cent of those questioned were in favour of the plan.

poll

(noun). cuộc thăm dò, khảo sát

A recent poll suggests some surprising changes in public opinion.

astronomy

(noun). thiên văn học

Unlike astronomy, astrology cannot be described as an exact science.

horticulture

(noun). nghề làm vườn

In Florida, women farmers run more than 8,000 farms and horticulture operations on their own or as partners.

ornithology

(noun). điểu học, ngành nghiên cứu chim

And is it not this inner life, this human significance in bird nature, this soul of ornithology, that we are all aiming to discover?

meteorology

(noun). khí tượng học

Outside meteorology, his research interests were in psychology.

hydrology

(noun). thuỷ văn

A more serious threat came from changes in the area's hydrology.

palaeontology

(noun). cổ sinh vật học

Palaeontology is the study of fossils and the evolution of life on Earth.

co-operation

(noun). hợp tác làm việc

They offered their cooperation on the project.

collaboration

(noun). sự cộng tác

It was a collaboration that produced extremely useful results.

reliant

(adjective). phụ thuộc

The hostel is heavily reliant upon charity.

crackpot

(noun). người có những ý tưởng khác biệt

They obviously think we’re a bunch of crackpots.

observation

(noun). sự quan sát

Most information was collected by direct observation of the animals' behaviour.

invaluable

(adjective). rất giúp ích, hữu dụng

The book will be invaluable for students in higher education.

specific

(adjective). riêng biệt

The money was collected for a specific purpose.

global

(adjective). mang tính toàn cầu

This year the global economy will grow by about 4 per cent.

helpful

(adjective). hữu ích

Sorry I can't be more helpful.

possible

(adjective). khả thi

New technology has made it possible to communicate more easily.

dinosaur

(noun). khủng long

This computer's a dinosaur, isn't it?

involvement

(noun). sự tham gia, có liên quan

Being on the committee is one involvement I could do without.

recruit

(verb). tuyển dụng

The police are trying to recruit more officers from ethnic minorities.

popularity

(noun). sự nổi tiếng

Her novels have gained in popularity over recent years.

fossil

(noun). hoá thạch

fossils over two million years old

universal

(adjective). toàn cầu

Such problems are a universal feature of old age.

conversation

(noun). cuộc đối thoại

The main topic of conversation was the likely outcome of the election.

association

(noun). tổ chức, công ty

The British Medical Association is/are campaigning for a complete ban on tobacco advertising.

birdwatcher

(noun). Người quan sát nhận dạng chim

To the trained eye of a birdwatcher, no two eagles look the same.

role

(noun). vai trò

I welcome the opportunity to assume a leadership role within the organization.

establishment

(noun). thiết lập

The visa is for foreign nationals wishing to study at a university, college or similar educational establishment.

migration

(noun). di cư

It was one of the largest mass migrations in US history.

reveal

(verb). tiết lộ

Her expression revealed nothing.

prompt

(verb). khuyến khích

She was too nervous to speak and had to be prompted.

acknowledge

(verb). công nhận

The country acknowledged his claim to the throne.

alternative

(adjective). khác

The road was closed so we had to find an alternative route.

productive

(adjective). hiệu suất tốt

The aim was to maximize the machine’s productive capacity.

coin

(verb). làm tiền xu, sáng chế

A new 50 pence piece was coined to commemorate the poet's bicentennial. Kraft coined the term "middle America" in the 1960s.

disparage

(verb). cho rằng cái gì đó không quan trọng, giá trị

I don't mean to disparage your achievements.

contribution

(noun). sự đóng góp

We rely entirely on voluntary contributions.

instructive

(adjective). đưa nhiều thông tin hữu ích

It was a most instructive experience.

pastime

(noun). trò tiêu khiển

Watching television is still the most popular national pastime.

volunteer

(verb). tình nguyện

Schools need volunteers to help children to read.

recreational

(adjective). mang tính giải trí

These areas are set aside for public recreational use.

accident

(noun). tai nạn

He was killed in an accident.

dangerous

(adjective). nguy hiểm

The situation is extremely dangerous.

blow somebody to bits

(verb). đánh bom, dùng vũ khí để tiêu diệt ai đó / cái gì đó

The plane was blown to pieces when the bomb exploded.

promote

(verb). thăng cấp

She worked hard and was soon promoted.

silence

(noun). im lặng

I need absolute silence when I'm working.

critic

(noun). nhà phê bình

Bradley Cooper's gripping performance has been praised by critics.

exclusive

(adjective). độc quyền

The hotel has exclusive access to the beach.

valuable

(adjective). đánh giá

My home is my most valuable asset.

technology

(noun). kỹ thuật

This technology enables computers to read handwriting.

development

(noun). sự phát triển

This is a perfectly normal stage of development.

high-tech

(adjective). công nghệ cao

This weapons system is an affordable, hi-tech solution.

equipment

(noun). trang thiết bị

They have installed state-of-the-art medical equipment to help improve early diagnosis of the condition.

sensor

(noun). thiết bị cảm biến

The security device has a heat sensor which detects the presence of people and animals.

reflect

(verb). thể hiện

Our newspaper aims to reflect the views of the local community.

citizen

(noun). công dân

The defeat of the president did not change the lives of ordinary citizens for the better.

praise

(verb). khen ngợi

He praised his team for their performance.

asteroid

(noun). tiểu hành tinh

Scientists are hoping an asteroid will clue them in about early life on earth.

comet

(noun). sao chổi

There have been several missions to comets over the past 20 years.

variable

(noun). biến số

With so many variables, it is difficult to calculate the cost.

supernovae

(noun). vụ nổ sao siêu mới

Such cavities might be created by stellar winds and supernovae.

coverage

(noun). độ bao phủ

Media coverage of the march focused on the few fights that broke out.

trend

(noun). xu hướng

There is a growing trend towards later retirement.

specialization

(noun). chuyên môn hoá

The lawyer said that he was unable to help us because our case fell outside his specialization.

edifice

(noun). toà nhà

The town hall is the only edifice surviving from the 15th century.

foundation

(noun). nền móng

The foundations will have to be reinforced to prevent the house from sinking further into the ground.

no-go area

(noun). khu vực cấm vào

A no-go area is a place which is controlled by a group of people who use force to prevent other people from entering it.

rocketry

(noun). khoa nghiên cứu sử dụng lựu đạn

This is all new for a country that does not have a deep history of rocketry or launching satellites into space.

migratory

(adjective). có tập tính di cư

The Rio Grande is a major migratory corridor for birds.

enlist

(verb). nhờ sự giúp đỡ

The organization has enlisted the support of many famous people in raising money to help homeless children.

unknown

(adjective). không quen thuộc, không biết

The exact number of people carrying the virus is unknown.

acoustics

(noun). độ vang âm

The acoustics in the recital hall are very good.

sections.title: Passage 2: Reading The Screen
sections.html:
literacy

(noun). trình độ học vấn

We’re looking to hire an assistant with a high level of digital literacy.

external

(adjective). phía bên ngoài

Female kangaroos carry their young in pouches that are external to their bodies.

debate

(noun). tranh luận

After a long debate, Congress approved the proposal.

opposing

(adjective). đối lập nhau

It is time for opposing factions to unite and work towards a common goal.

equally

(adverb). bằng nhau

Diet and exercise are equally important.

convincing

(adjective). thuyết phục

He was far from convincing as a leader.

technical

(adjective). thuộc mảng kỹ thuật

We offer free technical support for those buying our software.

relevant

(adjective). có liên quan

The decision was in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Police Act 1996.

social

(adjective). xã hội

The film addresses serious social issues.

context

(noun). bối cảnh

Such databases are being used in a wide range of contexts.

gain

(verb). lấy được, dành được

They managed to gain access to secret files.

lose

(verb). mất cái gì đó

The tickets seem to have got lost.

power

(noun). năng lượng, quyền lực

He has the power to make things very unpleasant for us.

industrialization

(noun). sự công nghiệp hoá

There is a rapid industrialisation of Asian countries.

manufacturer

(noun). nhà sản xuất

Always follow the manufacturer's instructions.

instruction

(noun). chỉ dẫn

Follow the instructions on the packet carefully.

appropriate

(adjective). phù hợp

Now that the problem has been identified, appropriate action can be taken.

decision

(noun). quyết định

We need a decision on this by next week.

incorporate

(verb). kết hợp, gộp chung

The new car design incorporates all the latest safety features.

production

(noun). sự sản xuất

The new plant is due to begin production next year.

stimulus

(noun). kích thích

Books provide children with ideas and a stimulus for play.

camcorder

(noun). máy thu, ghi hình

Experimental sessions were video-recorded using an 8 mm camcorder.

integrate

(verb). tích hợp

These programs will integrate with your existing software.

exposure

(noun). phơi bày

There were damaging exposures of the government's own practices.

cultural

(adjective). Về mặt văn hóa

Teachers need to be aware of cultural differences.

information

(noun). thông tin

What was your main source of information for your article?

heritage

(noun). di sản, tài sản kế thừa

The building is part of our national heritage.

doubtful

(adjective). nghi ngờ, không chắc chắn

Rose was doubtful about the whole idea.

broadcast

(verb). phát sóng

Most of the programmes are broadcast in English.

analyse

(verb). phân tích

The job involves collecting and analysing data.

readily

(adverb). sẵn sàng

All ingredients are readily available from your local store.

distinction

(noun). sự phân biệt rạch ròi

Philosophers did not use to make a distinction between arts and science.

literate

(adjective). biết chữ

Though nearly twenty he was barely literate.

illiterate

(adjective). mù chữ

A large percentage of the rural population was illiterate.

adequate

(adjective). cân xứng, đầy đủ

They'll need an adequate supply of hot water.

crucial

(adjective). tối quan trọng

The next few weeks are going to be crucial.

amount

(noun). số lượng

I was amazed at the amount he could eat.

certain

(adjective). chắc chắn

She wasn’t certain (that) he had seen her.

industrial

(adjective). liên quan đến công nghiệp

The fund provides money to clean up chemically polluted industrial sites.

society

(noun). xã hội

She believes that the arts benefit society as a whole.

extended

(adjective). nhiều hơn bình thường

More staff will be needed when the extended opening hours are introduced.

grasp

(verb). hiểu hoàn toàn về cái gì đó

They failed to grasp the importance of his words.

necessary

(adjective). cần thiết

It may be necessary to buy a new one.

overall

(adjective). nhìn chung

There will be winners in each of three age groups, and one overall winner.

decline

(verb). sụt giảm

Support for the party continues to decline.

uniform

(adjective). đồng bộ

The walls were a uniform grey.

reward

(verb). khen thưởng

She was rewarded for her efforts with a cash bonus.

increase

(verb). tăng

Costs have increased significantly.

certainly

(adverb). chắc chắn

Without treatment, she will almost certainly die.

central

(adjective). trung tâm

There will be rain later in central and eastern parts of the country.

anecdotal

(adjective). dựa vào những gì mọi người thấy hơn là sự thật, không hoàn toàn đúng

There is only anecdotal evidence that the medicine works.

manuscript

(noun). giấy tờ viết tay, bản thảo

He submitted the manuscript to an editor at Longman.

tabloid

(noun). báo đăng tin tức vắn tắt

She had no desire to embroil herself in lengthy lawsuits with the tabloid newspapers.

illustrate

(verb). minh hoạ

She illustrated her own books.

decrease

(verb). suy giảm

The number of new students decreased from 210 to 160 this year.

simplification

(noun). quá trình đơn giản hoá

Complaints have led to (a) simplification of the rules.

syntax

(noun). cú pháp

The examples should always illustrate correct syntax.

formal

(adjective). trang trọng

He kept the tone of the letter formal and businesslike.

education

(noun). việc giáo dục

She completed her formal education in 2019.

compilation

(noun). sự sản xuất

Her latest album is a compilation of all her best singles.

retain

(verb). giữ lại

He struggled to retain control of the situation.

topical

(adjective). Mang tính thời sự

They met to discuss matters of topical interest.

usurp

(verb). Chiếm, chiếm đoạt; tiếm quyền, cướp quyền

Democratically elected representatives should not be usurped by pressure groups.

undermine

(verb). phá hoại

Our confidence in the team has been seriously undermined by their recent defeats.

mechanics

(noun). cơ khí

The goals are the same, but the mechanics for achieving the goals differ greatly.

handbook

(noun). sách chỉ dẫn

A study skills handbook sets out to train the students in all these areas.

inadequate

(adjective). không đủ

The system is inadequate for the tasks it has to perform.

productive

(adjective). hiệu suất tốt

I just wish he would do something productive with his life.

enfranchise

(verb). cho quyền bầu cử

Women in Britain were first enfranchised in 1918.

acquiesce

(verb). ưng thuận, đồng ý

Senior government figures must have acquiesced in the cover-up.

affair

(noun). Nội cuộc

We are expecting a statement from the home affairs.

pessimistic

(adjective). bi quan

They appeared surprisingly pessimistic about their chances of winning.

erode

(verb). xói mòn, ăn mòn

The cliff face has been steadily eroded by the sea.

futuristic

(adjective). rất hiện đại, dành cho tương lai

A futuristic car was on display at the auto show.

progressive

(adjective). Tỏ ra tiến bộ, cải cách nhanh chóng

There's been a progressive decline in the standard of living over the past few years.

crisis

(noun). khủng hoảng

The country's leadership is in crisis.

The Renaissance

(noun). thời kỳ Phục hưng

The Renaissance was a period in European history marking the transition from the Middle Ages to modernity and covering the 15th and 16th centuries.

disadvantage

(noun). bất lợi

One disadvantage of living in the town is the lack of safe places for children to play.

institution

(noun). tổ chức, viện

Harvard University is an internationally respected institution.

opposition

(noun). chống đối

There is a lot of opposition to the proposed changes.

encounter

(verb). chạm trán, gặp gỡ

When did you first encounter these difficulties?

economically

(adverb). tiết kiệm

As a student she lived very economically, rarely going out and buying very few clothes.

sections.title: Passage 3: The Revolutionary Bridges of Robert Maillart
sections.html:
development

(noun). sự phát triển

This is a perfectly normal stage of development.

spark

(verb). phóng điện

The proposal would spark a storm of protest around the country.

structural

(adjective). mang tính hệ thống

Storms have caused structural damage to hundreds of homes.

invention

(noun). phát minh

Fax machines were a wonderful invention at the time.

automobile

(noun). xe hơi

Compressed natural gas can be used to power automobiles.

irresistible

(adjective). không cưỡng lại được, không chống lại được

I felt an irresistible urge to laugh.

vehicular

(adjective). (thuộc) xe cộ; dành cho xe cộ, gồm có xe cộ

The road is closed to vehicular traffic.

fundamental

(adjective). căn bản, cốt lõi

You have a fundamental right to privacy.

locomotive

(noun). đầu máy xe lửa

A steam locomotive is a type of railway locomotive that produces its pulling power through a steam engine.

sharply

(adverb). sắc bén

The report was sharply critical of the police.

curve

(noun). đường cong

He admired the delicate curve of her ear.

steeply

(adverb). một cách dốc đứng

The path climbed steeply upwards.

slope

(noun). dốc

Down the slope and beyond the road lay the Pacific Ocean.

respect

(noun). khía cạnh nào đó

This has been a difficult year in many respects.

unique

(adjective). đặc biệt, độc nhất

The preview offers a unique opportunity to see the show without the crowds.

method

(noun). phương pháp

Which method is the most effective?

enthusiastically

(adverb). một cách hứng thú

‘The new program is really well designed,’ she says enthusiastically.

stress

(verb). nhấn mạnh

He stressed the importance of a good education.

contemporary

(adjective). đương đại

The amphitheatre is roughly contemporary with the Colosseum in Rome.

analysis

(noun). phân tích

Further analysis revealed significant regional variations in the results.

eschew

(verb). tránh xa

He had eschewed politics in favour of a life practising law.

decorative

(adjective). để trang trí

The mirror is functional yet decorative.

architectural

(adjective). liên quan đến kiến trúc

Several architectural styles are being considered for the proposed housing development.

ornamentation

(noun). Sự trang hoàng, sự trang trí

The architect was instructed to keep ornamentation to a minimum.

imitate

(verb). bắt chước

Her style of painting has been imitated by other artists.

solely

(adverb). duy nhất

She was motivated solely by self-interest.

intuition

(noun). trực giác

He was guided by intuition and personal judgement.

creative

(adjective). mang tính sáng tạo

She channels her creative energy into her art.

knack

(noun). sở trường

It's easy, once you've got the knack.

competitive

(adjective). mang tính cạnh tranh

Graduates have to fight for jobs in an increasingly competitive market.

proposal

(noun). đề nghị

His proposal that the system should be changed was rejected.

rival

(noun). đối thủ

Marlowe was Shakespeare's main rival at the beginning of his career.

initial

(adjective). ban đầu

The government will make an initial investment of $ 4.7 billion in the company.

steel

(noun). thép

Small steel plates were attached to the front and back of the bone.

elegant

(adjective). quý phái

She was tall and elegant.

innovation

(noun). đổi mới

The company is very interested in product design and innovation.

substantial

(adjective). đáng kể

There are substantial differences between the two groups.

minimise

(verb). giảm thiểu

Good hygiene helps to minimize the risk of infection.

conventional

(adjective). thông thường

She's very conventional in her views.

hollow

(adjective). trống rỗng

The tree trunk was hollow inside.

diagram

(noun). biểu đồ

The results are shown in diagram 2.

arch

(adjective). dẻo miệng

He tapped the side of his nose in an uncharacteristically arch gesture.

masterpiece

(noun). tuyệt tác

The museum houses several of his Cubist masterpieces.

essential

(adjective). thiết yếu

Mobile phones are undoubtedly essential in modern life.

slender

(adjective). mảnh mai

Those jeans make you look very slender.

publicity

(noun). sự công khai

There has been a great deal of publicity surrounding his disappearance.

contrary

(adjective). đối lập

Contrary to popular belief, many cats dislike milk.

brilliance

(noun). sáng chói

They were speechless by the brilliance of the nature.

refinement

(noun). sự tinh luyện

This particular model has a further refinement.

persistent

(adjective). bền bỉ, kiên định

How do you deal with persistent salesmen who won't take no for an answer?

breakthrough

(noun). bước đột phá

The new deal represents a major breakthrough for the company.

invert

(verb). đảo ngược, lộn ngược

Place a plate over the cake tin and invert it.

compression

(noun). Sự nén

Tectonic forces caused compression in the earth’s crust.

transverse

(adjective). đặt cái gì đó nằm ngang

A transverse bar joins the two posts.

justify

(verb). biện minh

How can they justify paying such huge salaries?

accurately

(adverb). một cách chính xác

The report accurately reflects the current state of the industry.

achievement

(noun). thành tựu

It was a remarkable achievement for such a young player.

ravine

(noun). thung lũng hẹp và sâu

The track continued along the bottom of the ravine.

brook

(noun). suối

We'll have to cross the brook to get to the road.

designate

(verb). chỉ định

This area has been designated (as) a National Park.

historical

(adjective). mang tính lịch sử

You must place these events in their historical context.

landmark

(noun). cột mốc

The ceasefire was seen as a major landmark in the fight against terrorism.

exhibition

(noun). triển lãm

Have you seen the Picasso exhibition?

dominant

(adjective). ưu thế

The dominant feature of the room was the large fireplace.

generation

(noun). thế hệ

My generation have grown up with the internet.

column

(noun). cột

The website has an attractive two-column format.

transfer

(verb). di chuyển tới

He has been transferred to a psychiatric hospital.

arch

(noun). Khung tò vò, cửa tò vò

In many churches the side aisles are separated from the central aisle by a row of arches.

relatively

(adverb). khá, vừa phải, có mức độ, tương đối

This bottle is relatively expensive.

thick

(adjective). dày

She picked up a thick volume and began to read out loud.

vertical

(adjective). thẳng đứng

She looked over the cliff and found she was standing at the edge of a vertical drop.

roadway

(noun). đường xe chạy

An overturned bus was blocking the roadway.

form

(verb). hình thành

A crowd formed around the accident.

crucial

(adjective). quan trọng

Her work has been crucial to the project's success.

incorporate

(verb). Hợp thành tổ chức, hợp thành đoàn thể

Suggestions from the survey have been incorporated into/in the final design.

substantially

(adverb). Về thực chất, về căn bản

This model has leather seats, but the two cars are substantially the same.

expense

(noun). Sự tiêu; phí tổn

Buying a bigger car has proved to be well worth the expense.

concrete

(noun). bê tông

The bomb shelter has concrete walls that are three metres thick.

minimize

(verb). làm giảm

We must minimize the risk of infection.

commission

(noun). Tiền hoa hồng

You get a 10 per cent commission on everything you sell.

aesthetic

(adjective). về mặt mỹ thuật

This view is such aesthetic.

appearance

(noun). ngoại hình

She had never been greatly concerned about her appearance.

capitalise

(verb). cấp vốn, chuyển thành vốn

One option would be to capitalize part of your pension.

spectacular

(adjective). ngoạn mục

The coastal road has spectacular scenery.

terrain

(noun). địa hình

They walked for miles across steep and inhospitable terrain.

vault

(noun). tầng hầm

She is to be buried in the family vault.
